svg.title: Current checks
svg.desc: baseline-plumbing-pilot/ reports four model episodes across click-test-2 and enter-text, using the same initial binary in both named arms to check binary selection and broker plumbing. All four reached full reward, all profiles were removed, and transcript audit found no forbidden tools. Serial episode durations were 17.0–22.8 seconds. These two easy tasks do not predict full-suite speed or success. The raw pilot is /var/folders/l0/f73q0dln26v1fk40dxfc_w9h0000gn/T/umbra-runtime-k_tqurzx/external-plumbing-pilot-v2; hashes identify every retained raw file.
